English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #false Fake Image of Omaya Kovilagodage and President Anura Kumara Uncovered False FactSeeker has observed a photo circulating on social media that falsely appears to show Sirasa TV news anchor Omaya Kovilagodage holding hands with President Anura Kumara Dissanayake. by Anonymous | April 28, 2025 After verification, FactSeeker confirms that the image is a digitally altered fake intended to mislead the public. The original, authentic photo,which has been manipulated — was posted by journalist Omaya Kovilagodage on her Facebook page in 2023. FactSeeker urges the public to be vigilant against misleading content and to verify information before sharing it social media. We are an independent fact-checking team affiliated with the Sri Lanka Press Institute(SLPI). The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
